occurrences.text: And suddenly there came a sound from heaven as of a rushing mighty wind, and it filled all the house where they were sitting.
Neither is worshipped with men’s hands, as though he needed any thing, seeing he giveth to all life, and breath, and all things;

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
